statement: Invoice retrieval enforces authenticated same-tenant access: fetch_invoice returns invoice data only when the caller is authenticated and the caller's tenant_id matches the invoice's tenant_id.
evidence_for: service.py:5-6 raises PermissionError when may_read is False
service.py:7 returns data only after the guard
controller.py:4 delegates directly with no bypass
evidence_against: service.py:4 fetches records[invoice_id] before the guard, but the object is not returned until line 7
next_actions: Settle surface with REJECTED false-positive candidates and note the None==None tenant edge as a limitation
